title: Battle of Saumur (1793)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Saumur (1793)", at revision 1370588764, opens: "The Battle of Saumur took place during the Vendee Revolt. It occurred in the town of Saumur on 11 June 1793." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889940, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1793 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
